card.name: In vitro enzyme inhibition thresholds
card.fires_on: Digits and spaces inside inhibition cutoffs like IC50 or Ki >100 micromolar, and linking words in in-vitro enzyme-inhibition sentences. Seen in drug interaction sections on CYP enzymes.

modes.label: Inside inhibition cutoff numbers
modes.description: The space or digit within a '>' value such as >100 after Ki or IC50.

modes.label: Words in enzyme-test sentences
modes.description: Small words in sentences about what a drug did or did not inhibit in liver microsome tests.
